svg.text: Make one. Tube 26.9 x 3.2 mm: a 500 mm straight shank, then a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: half-turn bend of 400 mm radius, then a 250 mm nose.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bend cold on a former; no kinks. Round the nose end smooth.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Line eye: 44 mm washer plate, 24 mm hole, welded at the nose.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Spigot: 35.5 mm tube, 150 mm long, welded into the shank end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with the button lock, to fit any pole section.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It is a separate tool. It never fixes to the band.
